grain: latest available country-indicator value within query window
attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators; include indicator names, codes, retrieval window and source notes when reusing.
license_note: World Bank open data is generally CC BY 4.0; check indicator-level metadata and upstream-source conditions for each series.
known_limitations: the downloader stores the last observation within 2015-2022 rather than a synchronized single-year panel
historical API retrieval timestamp and revision vintage were not recorded by the legacy extraction
missingness is non-random across income and region groups
the cross-section is descriptive; it does not identify causal effects or current country performance
